prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE transparent 2D animation sprite sheet with FOUR COMPLETE CHARACTER drawings in a precisely spaced 2 by 2 grid, read top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Square canvas. Four equal square cells, invisible borders, each character fully inside its own cell with 8% empty margins. No labels, panels, text captions, floor, shadows, background, motion streaks or duplicated body parts. Truly transparent alpha.
Image 1 is the identity/style reference: chibi blue gradient wavy hair, ahoge, blue-white whale ears and blue whale tail, orange asterisk hair clip, cream hoodie with caramel bow and orange sleeve asterisks, small flower patch on pocket, tan pleated skirt and white frill, white flower legwarmers, brown Mary Jane shoes. Preserve identity, head/body ratio, rendering style and camera across ALL FOUR drawings. Badge says exactly "Claude" in black on white, orange rim; do not replace it with a flower. Each pose is a complete organically drawn body, two arms/hands and two legs only. No paper cutout articulation. Character's scale and horizontal center identical in every cell. Action: 点击回应-元气挥手, clearly visible cheerful wave. Front facing, feet planted same baseline. Frame 1: relaxed neutral, both hands down, soft smile. Frame 2: character's RIGHT arm (viewer LEFT) lifts from shoulder; elbow bent, open hand raised beside head with palm visible, happy open eyes. Left arm stays down. Frame 3: right forearm and open palm tilt OUTWARD to viewer LEFT, elbow remains attached naturally, sleeve folds respond, happy smile. Frame 4: right forearm and palm tilt INWARD toward head to viewer RIGHT, elbow still high, smile and one friendly blink. Clear substantial waving arc, not tiny wrist jitter. Exactly TWO arms and TWO hands in every frame: raised right and lowered left. Sleeve remains naturally connected.
